mapper.sql: SELECT game_id, skill_key FROM public.character_skill_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND character_key = #{characterKey}
mapper.select: SELECT r.skill_key, s.name, s.status, s.max_level, r.sort_order, (s.skill_key IS NOT NULL) AS skill_exists, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.skill_effects e WHERE e.game_id = r.game_id AND e.skill_key = r.skill_key) AS effect_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.skill_processes p WHERE p.game_id = r.game_id AND p.skill_key = r.skill_key) AS process_count, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.skill_trigger_rules t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.skill_key) AS trigger_rule_count FROM public.character_skill_relations r LEFT JOIN public.skills s ON s.game_id = r.game_id AND s.skill_key = r.skill_key WHERE r.game_id = #{gameId} AND r.character_key = #{characterKey} ORDER BY r.sort_order, s.name NULLS LAST, r.skill_key

WITH attached AS (), objects AS ( SELECT o.skill_key, 'FORMULA'::text AS object_type, o.formula_key AS object_key, o.name, o.sort_order, jsonb_build_object('expression', o.expression)::text AS data_json FROM public.skill_formulas o JOIN attached a USING (game_id, skill_key) UNION ALL SELECT o.skill_key, 'EFFECT', o.effect_key, o.name, o.sort_order, jsonb_build_object('results', o.results, 'lifecycle', o.lifecycle)::text FROM public.skill_effects o JOIN attached a USING (game_id, skill_key) UNION ALL SELECT o.skill_key, 'STATE', o.state_key, o.name, o.sort_order, jsonb_build_object('stateType', o.state_type, 'detail', o.detail)::text FROM public.skill_internal_states o JOIN attached a USING (game_id, skill_key) UNION ALL SELECT o.skill_key, 'PROCESS', o.process_key, o.name, o.sort_order, jsonb_build_object('activationType', o.activation_type, 'steps', o.steps, 'cooldown', o.cooldown, 'effectBindings', o.effect_bindings, 'stateOperations', o.state_operations)::text FROM public.skill_processes o JOIN attached a USING (game_id, skill_key) UNION ALL SELECT o.skill_key, 'TRIGGER', o.rule_key, o.name, o.sort_order, jsonb_build_object('eventSource', o.event_source, 'conditionGroups', o.condition_groups, 'actions', o.actions, 'limits', o.limits)::text FROM public.skill_trigger_rules o JOIN attached a USING (game_id, skill_key) ) SELECT skill_key, object_type, object_key, name, sort_order, data_json FROM objects ORDER BY skill_key, object_type, sort_order, object_key

WITH attached AS () SELECT r.source_skill_key, r.source_type, r.source_key, r.field_path, r.target_type, r.target_skill_key, r.target_key, r.target_sub_key, CASE WHEN r.target_type IN ('ATTRIBUTE', 'SKILL', 'CATEGORY', 'DAMAGE_TYPE', 'MODIFIER_ZONE', 'STATUS') THEN r.target_skill_key = '' AND r.target_sub_key = '' AND CASE r.target_type WHEN 'ATTRIBUTE' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.attributes t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.attribute_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'SKILL' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skills t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'CATEGORY' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_categories t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_category_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'DAMAGE_TYPE' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.damage_types t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.damage_type_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'MODIFIER_ZONE' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.modifier_zones t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.modifier_zone_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'STATUS' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.statuses t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.status_key = r.target_key) ELSE false END WHEN r.target_type IN ('PARAMETER', 'FORMULA', 'EFFECT', 'STATE', 'PROCESS', 'LIFECYCLE') THEN r.target_sub_key = '' AND CASE r.target_type WHEN 'PARAMETER' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_parameters t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.parameter_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'FORMULA' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_formulas t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.formula_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'EFFECT' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_effects t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.effect_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'STATE' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_internal_states t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.state_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'PROCESS' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_processes t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.process_key = r.target_key) WHEN 'LIFECYCLE' THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_effects t WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.effect_key = r.target_key AND jsonb_typeof(t.lifecycle) = 'object') ELSE false END WHEN r.target_type = 'RESULT' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_effects t, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.results) = 'array' THEN t.results ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) child WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.effect_key = r.target_key AND child->>'resultKey' = r.target_sub_key) WHEN r.target_type = 'STEP' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_processes t, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.steps) = 'array' THEN t.steps ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) child WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.process_key = r.target_key AND child->>'stepKey' = r.target_sub_key) WHEN r.target_type = 'OPTION' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_internal_states t, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.detail->'options') = 'array' THEN t.detail->'options' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) child WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.state_key = r.target_key AND t.state_type = 'MODE' AND child->>'optionKey' = r.target_sub_key) WHEN r.target_type = 'ACTION' THEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.skill_trigger_rules t, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(t.actions) = 'array' THEN t.actions ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) child WHERE t.game_id = r.game_id AND t.skill_key = r.target_skill_key AND t.rule_key = r.target_key AND child->>'actionKey' = r.target_sub_key) ELSE false END AS target_exists FROM public.skill_object_references r JOIN attached a ON a.game_id = r.game_id AND a.skill_key = r.source_skill_key ORDER BY r.source_skill_key, r.source_type, r.source_key, r.field_path, r.target_type, r.target_skill_key, r.target_key, r.target_sub_key
